test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_lc_nullable_is_null (s LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), u LowCardinality(Nullable(UInt32))) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_lc_nullable_is_null SELECT if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, concat('value_', toString(number % 1000))), if(number % 10 = 3, NULL, toUInt32(number % 200)) FROM numbers_mt(700000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM test_lc_nullable_is_null WHERE s IS NULL SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM test_lc_nullable_is_null WHERE s IS NOT NULL SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM test_lc_nullable_is_null WHERE u IS NOT NULL SETTINGS max_threads = 1
